Name: -1_hotel_beach_palace_food
Representative_Docs: ['Back less than a week from the El Hana Palace (now Caruso palace). Booked independently and travelled with my sister - she had been there many times before but this was only my second time in Tunisia - the first time I was there was in September 2001 and stayed in the Golf Residence. After that experience I swore I would never go back as I did not sleep a wink due to the noise from the Aqua Park. The El Hana Palace must have been something when it was first built. From the road it does not look much but the reception, the layout, the garden area between reception ane the villa, the situatuion of the pool all required effort and imagination. Unfortunately being a small hotel the previous owners probably took every penny out of operation and did not invest back into the', "My daughter Grandgaughter and friend went on the 11th may for11 nights,so wheretalking mixed age group here. nice sea view. The front view looks like your over looking Beirut.All the. staff are good.Our room was kept clean every day with clean towels and with a child it was in a mess. You can also get late supper,which we found handy as we didn't always want to eat till late after so much food at lunch and pancakes in the afternoon. They keep the food out to midnight but only the remains of the day which is fair enough.Our 6 year old loved the kids club but as it was term time therewasnt many other kids staying. She fell in love with the girls who ran it Lobna and Houda and Dians.They are so pretty and sweet. Don't bother with the pirate boat as you only go about half amile", 'Just back from a week in Sousse, at the Marhaba Beach Hotel, perfect base, to explore Sousse, hotel has direct access to the beach, and the medina centre, is only a few mins by taxi, and you can even walk there if you dont mind the stroll around 10-15 mins. The staff were very freindly, first time in Tunisia, and first time on an all inclusive holiday, the food was great, and fantastic choice. The hotel is in all honesty, dated in terms of rooms and reception decor, but we are never in our hotel, on most holidays, so it was fine. especially for the price - which was £304 pp 7 nights all inclusive. so cant ask for more, and had no complaints. port el kantoui is 5 mins taxi to the right - medina 5 mins taxi to the left, beach is right there!! food ample choice and great.']

Name: 2_hotel_tunisia_good_staff
Representative_Docs: ['2nd time to Tunisia 1st time to this hotel, after booking last minute to this hotel and reading the reviews we were really concerned, and the bad reviews are wrong!!!! Fantastic hotel, good food although towards the end a bit samely, as are most all inclusive hotels, staff are great, but as in most hotels if you are good to them they are good to you. Animation team excellent, beach great, weather beautiful. We are going back in September and cannot wait!!!!! 1 word can describe it "fantastic"!!!', "I stayed here with my wife for a week holiday. Never been to Tunisia before so was not sure what to expect and it was a very nice week away. We never went outside the hotel grounds apart from walks along the nice sandy beach. The hotel was good and the rooms were nice. A little basic and the bathrooms could do with being more updated. The pool was very nice and clean and the buffet restaurant was good to with plenty of choice. If your looking for total luxury or a 4 or 5 star then this is not the hotel for you. But it's a lot better than a 3 star. If you want a relaxing week away in the sun with some nice food and a comfortable room then this place will be good for you and for what you are paying you can't have any complaints either. We were happy here and would come back again", "I have recently come back from a weeks holiday from Tunisia, were we stayed at Marhaba beach. The hotel was very clean, and we had a lovely room with a sea view. We were a group of 7 and was worried that our rooms were far apart, but we were very close together which we were happy about!!
